<script lang="ts">
	import { setContext } from "svelte";
	import type { Props } from "./index.js";
	const { size = "md", children, class: className, ...props }: Props = $props();
	// Links read the size through a getter, so they follow changes to the prop.
	setContext("pagination-size", () => size);
</script>

<!-- Page navigation landmark. -->
<nav class={["pagination not-typeset", className]} aria-label="pagination" data-size={size} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</nav>

<style>
	/* Base pagination; centered in its container */
	.pagination {
		display: flex;
		justify-content: center;
		width: 100%;
	}
</style>
{@render children()}
More pages
• {@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { getContext } from "svelte";
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import type { LinkProps, ButtonAttrs } from "./index.js";
	const { isActive = false, size, children, ...props }: LinkProps = $props();
	const getSize = getContext<() => UiSize>("pagination-size");
	// Rest destructuring merges the button and link forms into one type, so the attributes are narrowed back to that union once here.
	const buttonAttrs = $derived(props as ButtonAttrs);
</script>

<!-- Square page link; the current page has an outline and is announced as the current page. -->
<Button variant={isActive ? "outline" : "ghost"} size="icon-{size ?? getSize()}" aria-current={isActive ? "page" : undefined} {...buttonAttrs}>
	{@render children()}
</Button>

description: Page navigation with previous and next links, page links, ellipses, and a page range helper.
